mood: Confident, editorial, asymmetric, brutalist but refined, modern SaaS.

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing. Overlapping and bento grids. Asymmetry.
spacing_and_layout.shadows: No soft shadows. Use sharp 1px borders or solid drop shadows (e.g. shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)] for CTAs).

components.buttons: Square edges, high contrast. Primary: bg-[#002BFF] text-white hover:bg-black hover:text-white transition-colors. Secondary: bg-transparent border border-black text-black hover:bg-black hover:text-white.
components.inputs: border border-black bg-white rounded-none focus:ring-0 focus:border-[#002BFF] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#002BFF]/20

interactions.hover: Invert colors or solid background shifts.

landing.layout: Asymmetric bento grid hero, large typography spanning multiple columns, stark white background with black grid lines.
landing.hero_image_behavior: Placed within a structural border. Overlay with grain.

dashboard.layout: Control Room Grid. Strict grid hierarchy, dense and compact. Sidebar with black border separating from main content.

editor.layout: 3-pane layout. Left: Thumbnails (border-r). Center: Main Canvas (grey bg). Right: AI Settings & Prompt (border-l).

images.description: Geometric light patterns cast on dark floor
Off-white and pale grey overlapping paper sheets, sharp edges
Dark mode abstract background, deep obsidian black, Klein Blue accent

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette: White background, Black borders, #002BFF primary buttons.
Do NOT use rounded corners anywhere. Use rounded-none.
Use data-testid on all interactive elements using kebab-case role-based names (e.g., login-button, new-presentation-card).
All text MUST be in Spanish.
Include the font imports for Clash Display and IBM Plex Sans in index.css.

For the presentation editor, structure it with a left sidebar for thumbnails, a center canvas, and a right sidebar for AI generation settings (provider selection: Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, model, and API key input).
Make the layout asymmetric and editorial, especially on the landing page.
